method: Status intervals use reviewed event and post-transition boundaries. Daily ratings use the arithmetic mean of unambiguous scores, one per date; other continuous status metrics retain their existing medians. No missing ratings are imputed; sleep values are displayed as hours and minutes. PEM-family counts include crash-documented dates; weekly rates use documented diary dates per complete Monday--Sunday week with >=5 structured PEM-assessment or detailed timed diary dates; require >=3 qualified weeks. Sparse and partial weeks are excluded and the actual adequately tracked window is stated. Short, explicitly documented crash episodes can be described qualitatively. Rates do not estimate clinical attack incidence or missing periods. No interpolation. Month-level milestones use reviewed exact anchors where available; otherwise month start is approximate.
